mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT( FROM_UNIXTIME( uui.user_reg_time ), '%Y年%m月' ) AS time, count(*) AS num FROM ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info_detail uui WHERE uui.user_reg_time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP( CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT( NOW(), '%Y' ), '-01-01 00:00:00' )) AND DATE_FORMAT( FROM_UNIXTIME( uui.user_reg_time ), '%Y年' ) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME( uui.user_reg_time ),'%Y%m')
select count(1) from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info_detail where user_id = #{userId} and user_identity_face_logo is not null and user_identity_font_logo is not null
select count(1) from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info where user_id = #{userId} and password is not null and password != ''
select count(1) from ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_user_base where user_id = #{userId} and user_pay_passwd is not null and user_pay_passwd != ''
mapper.update: update ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info set user_name =#{paraMap.userNickname} , user_nickname = #{paraMap.userNickname} where user_id = #{paraMap.userId}
mapper.select: select uui.user_id,uui.user_name,uui.user_state,uui.user_lastlogin_time,uui.user_lastlogin_ip,uui.user_is_new, uui.is_business,uui.is_delete,uui.user_mobile, uuuid.user_avatar,uui.user_nickname,uuuid.user_gender,uuuid.user_mobile_verify, uusb.seller_id,uusb.seller_name,uusb.shop_id,uusb.seller_is_admin,uusg.limits from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info uui LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_seller_base uusb ON uusb.user_id = uui.user_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_seller_group uusg ON uusg.group_id = uusb.seller_group_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info_detail uuuid ON uuuid.user_id = uui.user_id where uui.user_mobile = #{userMobile} and uui.user_state BETWEEN 0 and 2 limit 1
